data.name: CyberAgent
data.description: 面向授权目标的 Web/API 安全分析 Agent：通过自然语言维护任务、规划步骤、调用工具、沉淀上下文并生成可复现结论。

endpoints.description: 列出 Agent 会话摘要。
读取完整 Agent 会话。
读取可恢复 Agent state：task、todos、tool calls、context refs、next action。
读取轻量工作上下文：context refs、pending changes 和 run summary。
发送自然语言消息并触发 Agent 执行循环。
订阅 Agent session/activity 事件流。

capabilities.label: 自然语言运维/测试
capabilities.description: 将操作者意图转为任务、待办、工具调用和下一步建议。
examples: 列出最近运行并总结失败项

capabilities.label: 会话与上下文保持
capabilities.description: 保持聊天会话、任务状态、工具轨迹、上下文引用和下一步动作。

capabilities.label: 规划→工具→总结闭环
capabilities.description: 支持 JSON actions 与模型原生 tool_calls，执行低风险工具后回灌 observation 并生成最终总结。

capabilities.label: Web/API 安全运行时
capabilities.description: 可按明确授权指令启动 safe profile 扫描、跟踪运行、收集证据、处理审批并复测。

capabilities.label: Agent 工作区
capabilities.description: 为每个会话提供隔离工作区，支持文件列表、读取和低风险白名单命令。

stages.label: 理解
stages.description: 解析目标、scope、授权边界和操作者意图。

stages.label: 规划
stages.description: 生成 task/todos/next_action，并判断是否需要工具或人工确认。

stages.label: 工具调用
stages.description: 执行低风险内置工具；扫描和高风险动作需明确指令或审批。

stages.label: 观测
stages.description: 把工具结果沉淀为消息、工具轨迹和上下文引用。

stages.label: 总结
stages.description: 把 observation 回灌给 LLM，生成最终结论和下一步。

builtin_tools.name: workspace.command
builtin_tools.description: Run a low-risk allowlisted read-only command in the current Agent workspace. Allowed examples: pwd, ls, cat, head, tail, grep, find, wc, git status.

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.list
builtin_tools.description: List files in the current Agent workspace.

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.read
builtin_tools.description: Read a workspace-relative file from the current Agent workspace.

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.write
builtin_tools.description: Write or replace a workspace-relative file in the current Agent workspace when explicitly requested by the operator.

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.patch
builtin_tools.description: Patch a workspace-relative file by replacing one exact old text block with new text and returning a diff preview.

old.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.diff
builtin_tools.description: Create a staged workspace file change by replacing one exact old text block with new text; returns a diff preview and change_id without modifying the file.

old.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.diff_many
builtin_tools.description: Create one staged change set across multiple workspace files. Each item replaces one exact old text block with new text and returns a shared group_id plus per-file change_id values without modifying files.

old.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.rebase
builtin_tools.description: Regenerate a pending/conflict staged change by change_id using the current exact old text from the workspace file. The replacement defaults to the original staged new text; returns a new change_id and supersedes the old change.

change_id.description: Existing staged change ID to regenerate

old.description: Exact current text to replace; must occur exactly once

new.description: Optional replacement text; defaults to the original staged new text

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.apply
builtin_tools.description: Apply a previously staged workspace file change by change_id, a staged group by group_id, or all pending changes with all=true after validating old text still matches exactly once.

all.description: Apply all pending staged changes when explicitly requested

builtin_tools.name: workspace.files.discard
builtin_tools.description: Discard a previously staged workspace file change by change_id, a staged group by group_id, or all pending/conflict changes with all=true without modifying files.

all.description: Discard all pending/conflict staged changes when explicitly requested

builtin_tools.name: runs.approvals.list
builtin_tools.description: List pending approval requests for a specific run, or summarize the global approval queue when run_id is omitted.

builtin_tools.name: runs.approvals.approve
builtin_tools.description: Approve one pending approval when the operator explicitly asks to approve it. Requires run_id plus approval_id/step_id unless the active run has exactly one pending approval.

builtin_tools.name: runs.approvals.deny
builtin_tools.description: Deny one pending approval when the operator explicitly asks to reject it. Requires run_id plus approval_id/step_id unless the active run has exactly one pending approval.

builtin_tools.name: runs.resume_approved
builtin_tools.description: Resume approved steps for a run when the operator explicitly asks to resume approved work.

run_id.description: Run ID to resume; defaults to active run when omitted

safety.scope_policy: 默认只处理授权目标；目标、scope 或授权边界不清晰时等待用户确认。
safety.auto_execute_policy: LLM 自动执行仅限低风险内置工具；扫描需明确自然语言指令；外部插件/高风险动作进入审批 gate。

integrations.label: LLM providers
integrations.description: OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, and Ollama provider adapters.

integrations.label: Daemon runtime
integrations.description: Jobs, runs, events, reports, approvals, and safe-profile Web/API scan runtime.

integrations.label: Plugin registry
integrations.description: Built-in and external tool/plugin registry with policy gates.

integrations.label: Workspace
integrations.description: Per-session files and allowlisted command execution sandbox.
